almanactcm:morning-rankup: As you rest, the day's work settles into your hands: {0} {1}.
almanactcm:overstrike-crumble: Your hammer bites too deep and the sheared bit crumbles to scale. You breathe, reset your stance, and focus.
almanactcm:overstrike-slip: Your blow lands wide and shoves metal it was never meant to touch. You breathe, reset your stance, and focus.
almanactcm:bee-crush: The comb crushes in your grip. Breathe, and pull the next one clean.
almanactcm:unfitted-mark: The maker's work lies dormant. Fit it at a workbench.
almanactcm:masterwork-by: A masterwork vessel by {0}. It keeps what it holds.
almanactcm:masterwork-by-raw: A masterwork vessel by {0}, once it is fired.
almanactcm:gate-blocked: Your hands don't yet know how to work {0}. That takes {1} Metalworking.
almanactcm:gate-wasted: You force the unfamiliar {0} and ruin it. {1} Metalworking would have known better.
almanactcm:honed-mark: Honed. Its edge finds the gaps in armour.
almanactcm:durable-mark: Durable. Tempered to outlast hard use.
almanactcm:alloy-locked: The alloy ledger opens only to a Master of Metalworking.
almanactcm:alloy-footnote: 100 units make one ingot. Any mix inside the ranges yields this alloy.
almanactcm:instability-uneasy: This rock feels uneasy. It wants support.
almanactcm:instability-dangerous: This rock feels ready to come down.
almanactcm:spot-line-eta: {0}: regrows in {1} days, give or take a day.
almanactcm:spot-line-soon: {0}: should be back any day now.
almanactcm:spot-more: And {0} more patches in this stretch.
almanactcm:depth-title: The strata speak to practiced hands:
almanactcm:bore-title: The drill tells more in practiced hands:
almanactcm:cfg-focus-delay-c: How long you must hold a crouched look before the tracker's read resolves. 0 shows it instantly.
almanactcm:cfg-vignette-intensity-c: How dark the screen edges get while focusing. 0 turns the vignette off entirely.
almanactcm:cfg-vignette-reach-c: How far the darkening creeps inward. Lower is a tighter tunnel, higher hugs the edges.
almanactcm:cfg-blood-visibility-c: How much your hunting rank swings a wounded animal's blood trail around its stock look. Stock shows at Journeyman. 0 turns the rank effect off. Higher means a fainter trail for a novice and a richer one for a master.
almanactcm:cfg-blood-persistence-c: How much your hunting rank swings how long a blood trail lingers. Stock duration shows at Journeyman. 0 turns the rank effect off. Higher means a shorter-lived trail for a novice and a longer one for a master.
almanactcm:cfg-toasts-enabled-c: Float a small '+0.4 Mining' over the hotbar when practice lands. Off hides the toasts entirely; the Info-tab line and the Callings tab are unaffected.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-color-c: Text color as a hex code like #E8C36A. Accepts #RGB, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; an unreadable value falls back to the amber default.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-fontsize-c: Font size of the toast text, before GUI scaling.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-lifetime-c: How long a toast lives from spawn to fully faded.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-rise-c: How far the toast drifts upward over its lifetime, in interface pixels. 0 holds it still.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-merge-c: Gains in the same calling within this window fold into one toast whose number ticks up, instead of stacking new lines. Felling a tree is a burst; keep this above zero.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-max-c: Cap on simultaneous toasts. Overflow drops the oldest.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-offsety-c: Where the newest toast spawns, in interface pixels above the bottom edge. The default sits over the hotbar.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-technique-c: Append the technique to the calling name, like '+0.4 Mining (quarrying)'.
almanactcm:track-sense: Sign of an animal to the {0}.
almanactcm:track-sense-moving: Sign of an animal to the {0}, moving {1}.
almanactcm:spot-water-eta: Back to full stock in about {0} days.
almanactcm:fish-escaped: The line goes slack. It got away, and it took the bait with it.
almanactcm:misfire-flash: A flash in the pan. The piece doesn't go off.
almanactcm:powder-spared: Practiced hands waste nothing. The reload cost you no powder.
almanactcm:powder-spilled: A clumsy pour. Powder scatters from the flask.
almanactcm:perfect-parry: A perfect parry. Your riposte finds the gap in the plates.
almanactcm:signature-by: Signature dish by {0}. It will keep.
almanactcm:heirloom-of: Heirloom of {0}. Bred for the yield.
almanactcm:heirloom-tail: This seed carries the strain for {0} more sowing(s).
almanactcm:mastersline-of: Master's Line of {0}. A pedigree bloodline.
almanactcm:flawless-by: Flawless glass by {0}. A master's work.
almanactcm:alc-master-by: A master remedy of {0}. Potent and sure.
almanactcm:tai-master-by: A master tailor's work, from the hand of {0}.
almanactcm:eng-millwrights-mark: The Millwright's Mark of {0} - runs true, and stays true.
almanactcm:tem-forecast: You feel it before the others: a {0} temporal storm is gathering, {1}.
almanactcm:tem-forecast-vague: A disturbance gathers in the weave of time, though how strong you cannot yet tell.
almanactcm:arc-backfire: You reached past your art, and the weave of time recoiled through you.
almanactcm:arc-school-rankup: Your command of {0} deepens. You are now a {1} of the school.
almanactcm:arc-memorycrystal: A stranger's practice, set in stone. Whatever this hand learned, it is not yours to keep. The reserves, though, still answer.
almanactcm:tame-gate: This wild hunter does not trust unpracticed hands. Its taming asks for surer Animal Handling than yours.
almanactcm:pot-stretched: A practiced hand at the pot. The batch stretches to an extra serving.
almanactcm:colliers-mark: Collier's Mark: burned by {0}. Takes a hotter, longer fire.
game:deathmsg-blockfalling-1: {0}, the tree did not appreciate that.
game:deathmsg-blockfalling-2: {0} found out which way the tree falls.
game:deathmsg-blockfalling-3: {0} was standing exactly where the tree wanted to be.
game:deathmsg-blockfalling-4: {0} chopped it down. It landed on them.
almanactcm:met-masterwork-by: A masterwork by {0}. The steel holds its temper.
almanactcm:eng-warming: Warming. No smoke yet, but it is building.
almanactcm:eng-read-effspeed: Speed at this part {0}  (warms {1}, smokes {2}, burns {3})
almanactcm:eng-read-shaft-opposed: Something on this shaft works against the rest.
almanactcm:eng-read-capacity-opposed: Torque capacity {0} ({1} lost to opposing sources), load {2}, headroom {3}
almanactcm:eng-read-surplus: Surplus {0}  (positive speeds up, zero is equilibrium)
almanactcm:eng-read-overspeed: Running {0}% past its limit. The further past, the sooner it goes.
almanactcm:cfg-discovery-banners-c: The lore-style banner that fades in when a rank is attained or a named piece of knowledge is earned. Off silences the banner; chat lines and the almanac's own pages are unaffected.
almanactcm:cfg-banner-opacity-c: Ink of the heraldic ribbon behind the banner text. Lower ghosts it; 0 removes it and leaves bare text.
almanactcm:cfg-banner-fontsize-c: Font size of the banner text, before GUI scaling.
almanactcm:cfg-banner-hold-c: How long the banner sits at full ink between its fade-in and fade-out. Queued banners wait their turn.
almanactcm:cfg-quest-toasts-c: The small parchment strip that ticks off a checklist line from the almanac's guides when your work closes it. Off silences the strip; the checklists in the book still fill in as normal.
